ELA-PHONICS-VTEAM-OA-01.subject: ELA
ELA-PHONICS-VTEAM-OA-01.name: Vowel Team "oa" (/oʊ/)
ELA-PHONICS-VTEAM-OA-01.concept: Identify words where vowel team oa spells the long o sound.

ELA-GRAM-PLURALS-01.subject: ELA
ELA-GRAM-PLURALS-01.name: Irregular Plural Nouns
ELA-GRAM-PLURALS-01.concept: Distinguish irregular plural nouns from regular -s/-es plurals and singular forms.

ELA-MORPH-PREFIX-UN-01.subject: ELA
ELA-MORPH-PREFIX-UN-01.name: Prefix "un-" (Not / Opposite)
ELA-MORPH-PREFIX-UN-01.concept: Recognize the prefix un- and distinguish from words with non-prefix un (e.g. uncle).

MATH-NUM-EVENODD-01.subject: MATH
MATH-NUM-EVENODD-01.name: Even and Odd Numbers
MATH-NUM-EVENODD-01.concept: Determine whether a group of objects or a number up to 100 has an odd or even number of members.

MATH-OA-FACTS20-01.subject: MATH
MATH-OA-FACTS20-01.name: Mental Addition Facts to 20
MATH-OA-FACTS20-01.concept: Fluently add and subtract within 20 using mental strategies.

MATH-NBT-PLACEVAL-01.subject: MATH
MATH-NBT-PLACEVAL-01.name: Three-Digit Place Value
MATH-NBT-PLACEVAL-01.concept: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones.
MATH-NBT-PLACEVAL-01.rule_prompt: Munch numbers with 4 in the Tens place!

MATH-G-SHAPES-01.subject: MATH
MATH-G-SHAPES-01.name: 2D Shape Attributes
MATH-G-SHAPES-01.concept: Recognize and draw shapes having specified attributes, such as a given number of angles or sides.

MATH-NBT-SUB-REGROUP-01.subject: MATH
MATH-NBT-SUB-REGROUP-01.name: 2-Digit Subtraction with Regrouping
MATH-NBT-SUB-REGROUP-01.concept: Subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value and properties of operations.

MATH-MD-TIME-01.subject: MATH
MATH-MD-TIME-01.name: Time to 5 Minutes
MATH-MD-TIME-01.concept: Tell and write time from analog and digital clocks to the nearest five minutes.

MATH-MD-MONEY-01.subject: MATH
MATH-MD-MONEY-01.name: Counting Coins & Making Change
MATH-MD-MONEY-01.concept: Solve word problems involving dollar bills, quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies.
